2026-11-14 (Loom projection slice, no migration). lib/loom/functions/usage.ts projects stored Loom declarations into a usage index (primitive -> functions, block type -> functions, stranded rows) with retirementImpact(), derived from rows a caller already read, so no new table. Dark behind EDITOR_CANVAS; check:loom-integrity arm M7 proves it is not vacuous. This closes the 'functions ALREADY STORED when a primitive is retired' blind spot the gate named. The consolidation half is untouched and the row stays open: block-systems is still 5 (scripts/block-baselines.json), and the probe needs 1.

2026-11-16 (PROG-E2A, owner approval Daniel 2026-11-16, ADR-1953). FINDING: the block-systems counter was counting the wrong five files. It listed two things that are not block systems (lib/email-studio/product-block.ts is send-time data binding for a block already in the registry; lib/library/element-catalog.ts is the Loom art catalog), pointed Spotlight at a directory that can never disappear (components/spotlight), and missed the two largest real systems in the EDITOR-ARCHITECTURE section 2.1 table: Layout modules (lib/widgets/modules.ts) and the Space profile catalog (lib/spaces/profile-blocks.ts). Corrected through the gate's own --update path, recorded as a rebase: the manifest is now the canon's five (lib/entity-blocks/registry.ts, lib/page-editor/config.tsx, lib/widgets/modules.ts, lib/spaces/profile-blocks.ts, lib/spotlight/blocks/schema.ts). The count reads 5 before and after; nothing was consolidated by this. SECOND FINDING: this row's probe could not read the file (it looked for a top-level block-systems key; the shape is entries[]), so it would have failed even at 1. The probe is now scripts/probes/builder/PROG-E2.mjs: same two requirements (a block_type_usage migration, and the value 1), reading entries[].baseline. Still open: all four folds. Order: Space profile, then Spotlight, then Layout modules, then Puck. The row stays open until block-systems reads 1.

2026-11-16 (PROG-E2B, the first fold). block-systems is 4, down from 5. The Space profile catalog (lib/spaces/profile-blocks.ts) is deleted; its fourteen sections are now derived from ENTITY_BLOCKS in lib/entity-blocks/space-profile.ts. No migration, no stored layout rewritten, the eleven core Space blocks untouched, no palette changed (the registry itself is not edited beyond two comments). Goldens written and run green against the old catalog first, then kept, freeze the list, the default layouts and the saved-id cleaning. Said plainly, what is NOT unified: (1) the renderer map in components/widgets/space-profile/space-profile-modules.tsx is still its own fourteen-key map, a second map to fold in a later PR; (2) the section called `highlights` in stored profile layouts reads the registry row `stats`, through a one-line id map, so no stored id changed; (3) three descriptions (About, Highlights, Offerings) keep the profile wording through a small override map because the two catalogs had drifted. FOR THE OWNER: pick one line of copy for each of those three, then the override map can go. Still open on this row: three folds, in order Spotlight (lib/spotlight/blocks/schema.ts), Layout modules (lib/widgets/modules.ts), Puck (lib/page-editor/config.tsx). The probe needs 1 and reads 4.

2026-11-16 (PROG-E2B, a finding from the fold, and a lesson for the next three). Deleting lib/spaces/profile-blocks.ts broke two CLOSED rows: LIVE-525 named it as its source file (check:backlog checks that path on every run), and the probes of LIVE-510 and LIVE-525 read the file's source text for a literal memberships row and a literal faq row. Neither row has a closed date, so the per-pull-request gate would have skipped both probes and the weekly full sweep would have reported two regressions with no author. The fold stopped there until the owner approved re-pointing both probes (Daniel, 2026-11-16 15:27Z). Both now load the derived list and assert the same consequences (scripts/probes/builder/LIVE-510.mjs, LIVE-525.mjs). LESSON, before each remaining fold (Spotlight, Layout modules, Puck): grep every row's source.file and verify probe, closed rows included, for the file about to be deleted, and get the owner's approval for each probe that must be re-pointed BEFORE writing the fold.

2026-11-16 (PROG-E2C, the second fold). block-systems is 3, down from 4. The Spotlight block kit moved from lib/spotlight/blocks/schema.ts to lib/entity-blocks/spotlight.ts, beside the registry; each of its nine types is held to a registry row a member may hold. Six probe and test re-points approved by the owner (16:50Z). Stored layouts, validation and rendered markup unchanged (goldens). Still open: Layout modules (lib/widgets/modules.ts) and Puck (lib/page-editor/config.tsx). The probe needs 1 and reads 3.

2026-11-16 CLOSED at the target of 2 (ADR-1955, owner rulings 17:26Z, 17:32Z, 17:33Z). Layout modules (lib/widgets/modules.ts) is reclassified as the page Apps catalog, not a block system: it leaves the counter's manifest and no file moves. The E2 target is 2: the entity-block registry and the website builder's Puck blocks. block-systems reads 2. The probe reads the target 2 in place of 1; both halves still hold (the block_type_usage migration, and the frozen value). The full Puck merge is not scheduled.

verify.note: Measures both halves of the E2 gate: a migration must ship the usage index (public.block_type_usage, PROG-D4), AND scripts/block-baselines.json must record block-systems at or below the target in entries[], with a matching frozen record. The target is 2 since ADR-1955 (owner ruling 2026-11-16: the registry plus the website builder's Puck blocks); it was 1 before. Fails while the count is above 2.
